zone.description: Only the Tailscale interface. SSH is always on; 22000 is Syncthing's sync protocol, which is not HTTP and cannot be fronted by Tailscale Serve. 8484 is the deploy receiver, which Serve forwards from the tailnet. The Immich, OPDShelf and Syncthing interfaces and the two agent web UIs publish on loopback and reach the tailnet through Serve, so they need no port here. Nothing listens on the LAN.
